artDirection.basic: Slightly cute; expressive eyes and compact heroic proportions; never infantilize.
artDirection.evolved: Cool and cute, stronger silhouette and more elaborate armor.
artDirection.final: Imposing and stylish, mature proportions and a clear power increase.

sources.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit the supplied eight-pose jade mantis sprite sheet. Preserve this exact green/gold scythe-mantis identity and polished hand-painted anime finish, FOUR columns by TWO rows, transparent alpha. Two corrections ONLY: (1) this is a BASIC-form monster, so make it a little cuter: slightly larger rounded head, larger expressive golden eyes, softer armor tips, compact athletic body; still a cool mantis, not a baby or plush toy. (2) Make every whole silhouette smaller in its own equal cell, leaving WIDE transparent gutters on all four sides. The upper-right attacking pose currently clips its right scythe: redraw the WHOLE scythe fully inside its cell with at least 40px clear margin to the image edge. No pose touches any image or cell edge. Keep 8 DIFFERENT poses with actual articulation: idle, inhale, draw-back, rightward scythe attack, follow-through, return guard, recoil, braced recovery. All face RIGHT; same head/body scale, no detached effects, no shadows, no labels, no watermark, no checkerboard. Strict landscape 2048x1024.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production 2D RPG eight-key-pose animation atlas. NEW MONSTER: a squat mossy teal swamp toad with huge rounded cheeks, ivory belly, small warm amber lantern-like toxin sacs along its back, reeds tucked around a copper-rimmed lotus crown, chunky grounded amphibian feet and gently fierce gold eyes; NO mushroom cap, distinct actual toad silhouette. Style: polished HAND-PAINTED ANIME RPG, beautifully sculpted soft cel shading, crisp colored contours, delicate material highlights, charming compact heroic proportions, match the existing game's painted ghost and candy knight finish rather than pixel art. TRUE TRANSPARENT alpha background. Landscape 2048x1024. STRICTLY FOUR equal columns and TWO equal rows, exactly 8 separate full-body drawings of the SAME creature. Every pose must remain within the central 70 percent of its own cell, with at least 15 percent clear transparent gutter on EVERY side; compact body and appendages, no cropped tips, no touching other poses. All face and attack to the RIGHT, three-quarter side view, same body size and proportions. Row-major pose order: 1 neutral ready idle; 2 gentle inhale (almost identical to idle); 3 readable wind-up crouch or draw-back; 4 decisive forward attack; 5 compact follow-through; 6 return to ready stance; 7 recoil from an incoming blow; 8 braced recovery. Real limb/body articulation rather than translated copies. Keep weapons and tails close enough to fit, avoid extreme foreshortening or head size drift. No ground shadow, no floor, no detached sparkles, no labels, no border lines, no watermark, no decorative corner logo, no checkerboard. Refined playful fantasy art, not photorealistic, not 3D render. Draw smaller creatures with extra wide empty margins. The monster itself occupies only 60% of each cell, NOT touching image edges. Expressive friendly anime eyes.
